versions.changelog: Add canonry.ai link to README header + footer (aero homepage now points at canonry.ai as well).

Refresh README + CLI reference: mention vs cited vocabulary as two first-class signals (Mention Coverage primary, Citation Coverage secondary), Mention Share metric, brand aliases, discovery workflow with --locations, cnry get for surgical reads, Vercel traffic adapter, --dry-run on supported mutations, updated agent CLI (providers/transcript/reset, --all fan-out, --trace).

Initial release of the Aero skill for AEO analyst orchestration.

- Coordinates comprehensive AEO monitoring via canonry (project state, GA4 analytics) and aeo-audit (site analysis, fix generation).
- Enforces strict memory rules: only persist user-scoped context; all project data must be re-queried.
- Integrates Google Analytics 4 as a first-class signal for traffic and attribution analysis.
- Implements judgment rules for prioritization, action recommendations, and communication standards.
- Provides detailed task-oriented playbooks and references for orchestration, regression response, discovery, and reporting.
